question: To uphold and protect the sovereignty, unity and integrity of India is a the:
solution:
The correct answer is **fundamental duty**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Fundamental Duties** are enshrined in Part IVA of the Indian Constitution under Article 51A.
 
• These duties were added by the 42nd Amendment Act of 1976, based on the recommendations of the Swaran Singh Committee.
 
• The purpose of these duties is to remind citizens that they have responsibilities in addition to rights.
 
• There are currently 11 fundamental duties listed in the Indian Constitution.
 
• One of these duties is to uphold and protect the **sovereignty, unity, and integrity** of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Duty
 Description
 
 
 
 

 To abide by the Constitution and respect its ideals and institutions
 This includes respecting the National Flag and the National Anthem.
 
 

 To cherish and follow the noble ideals
 These ideals inspired the national struggle for freedom.
 
 

 To uphold and protect the sovereignty, unity, and integrity of India
 This duty emphasizes the importance of national unity.
 
 

 To defend the country and render national service
 Every citizen is expected to be ready to defend the nation.
 
 

 To promote harmony and the spirit of common brotherhood
 This includes transcending religious, linguistic, and regional diversities.
 
 

 To value and preserve the rich heritage of our composite culture
 Citizens should take pride in India's cultural heritage.
 
 

 To protect and improve the natural environment
 This includes forests, lakes, rivers, and wildlife.
 
 

 To develop the scientific temper, humanism, and spirit of inquiry and reform
 Encourages rational thinking and questioning of superstitions.
 
 

 To safeguard public property and to abjure violence
 Protecting public assets and maintaining peace is crucial.
 
 

 To strive towards excellence in all spheres of individual and collective activity
 This ensures that the nation constantly rises to higher levels of achievement.
 
 

 To provide opportunities for education to children
 Parents or guardians must ensure their children get education.
